cases.problem: Implement s_pipeline. Retired stream LOAD r1; ALU r2 from r1; taken BRANCH reading r2; ALU r3 from r2 issues at1,3,4,7 with forwarding, lastWB11. Without forwarding it issues1,4,7,10, lastWB14. Supply full IF/ID/EX/MEM/WB diagrams including stalls and two branch bubbles. Show a write to constant r0 creates no dependence.

Implement s_i2c_drive/sample for one original byte primitive. Transmitting0x80 releases SDA on its first bit; sampled SCL0 must not advance, and later SCL1/SDA0 loses arbitration. Releasing SDA after loss is mandatory. Transmit every byte unchanged through eight samples then classify ninth ACK versus NACK. Derive identical-prefix two-controller histories before composing with the accepted transaction machine.

Implement s_checksum_add/finish over chunks. Bytes01,02,03,04,05 yield0xf6f9 regardless of any two split points, including empty chunks. Preserve an unmatched high octet between calls; pad only at finish. Empty yields0xffff; all-ones words yield0. Compare with the accepted contiguous packet checksum through an explicit numeric-value adapter.

Implement s_paired. A=[100,100,100,100,100],B=[90,91,92,93,10000] yields lower median(B-A)=-8 and four wins; the mean has a different sign. Four pairs use lower median=-9. Handle UINT32_MAX versus0 without unsigned wrap. Extend a reused consumed-result harness to collect paired raw samples and record warmup/order/clock assumptions; distinguish these actual observations from the supplied synthetic fixtures.

Implement s_reduce with complement chunks and a final deletion certificate. Original tokens[7,4,9,9,2,8] fail when4 precedes2; reduce to[4,2]. A stable callback classifies PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED. Never accept an unresolved candidate as the same failure. If a final single-deletion trial is unresolved, return PENDING unchanged rather than certify1-minimality. Budget1 must preserve all outputs.

Implement FIFO,LRU,OPTIMAL plus per-access eviction records, retaining existing CLOCK as an explicit comparison adapter. Reference1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5 gives FIFO9/10 faults with3/4 frames, OPTIMAL7/6, and three-frameLRU10. Independently enumerate every legal victim choice for tiny traces to validate greedy future lookahead.

Implement s_wait_event. Consumer locks and waits on false predicate atomically enrolling+unlocking; producer then locks,publishes,signals and unlocks; consumer becomes ready exactly once. A signal without publication wakes but leaves predicate false, so the consumer must recheck and reenroll. Enumerate producer before-check/during-enrollment/after-block schedules, marking lock-conflicting transitions invalid.

Implement shoot begin/ack/reclaim. Snapshot CPUs0,1; ACK0 alone leaves reclaim PENDING. A stale ACK1 from the prior generation cannot clear its pending bit. Only current ACK1 completes. Model the old frame containing synthetic labelOLD, then candidate reuse with labelNEW: the early-reclaim mutant permits a stale CPU view to observeNEW; corrected ordering prevents reuse until all captured CPUs invalidate.

Implement peer submit/ack/restart/ready. Submit(epoch1,seq1); restart without trusted quiescence remains PENDING and retains work. Trusted restart records uncertainty, advances epoch2,clears ready and retains an explicit result record. After ready2 submit seq1 again; stale ACK(1,1) must fail, ACK(2,1) succeeds. Exhaust epochs without wrapping. Explain how this composes with request completion ownership and supervisor evidence.
